name: veriqo
description: End-to-end testing for applications and AI agents

scripts.check: node scripts/check-workspace.mjs && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @veriqo/contracts typecheck && pnpm --filter @veriqo/db typecheck && pnpm --filter @veriqo/api typecheck && pnpm --filter @veriqo/coordinator typecheck && pnpm --filter @veriqo/web typecheck
scripts.test: node --import tsx --test --experimental-test-isolation=none packages/contracts/test/*.test.ts packages/db/test/*.test.ts apps/api/test/*.test.ts apps/coordinator/test/*.test.ts
